national_news.title: India Calls on BRICS Nations to Expand Opportunities for Women-Led Enterprises in Global Trade
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal addressed the BRICS WBA Women-Led Development Conference in New Delhi, advocating for easier credit access and predictable business rules for women entrepreneurs.
Highlighted national milestones including 300 million women bank account holders and 100 million rural women enrolled in over 9 million Self-Help Groups under the 'Lakhpati Didis' initiative.
Reiterated India's economic roadmap to scale from a $4 trillion economy to a $30 trillion economy by 2047.

national_news.title: India Ramps Up Flood Relief to Nepal with 8th Aid Flight and Specialized Rescue Teams
bullets: India dispatched its 8th IAF aircraft carrying 35 tonnes of supplies to Kathmandu, bringing total aid to over 130 tonnes alongside 54 specialized rescue and forensic personnel.
Indian assistance includes DNA profiling kits, mud rescue gear, dewatering pumps, and technical equipment handed over by Ambassador Naveen Srivastava to Nepal's Minister Mahabir Pun.
Specialized Indian tunnel rescue teams initiated joint operations with the Nepali Army to navigate high-risk sites in Chilime and Langtang.

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal Reviews Preparedness for Nationwide 'Swachhata Hi Seva 2026'
bullets: Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs Manohar Lal reviewed preparations with States/UTs for the 'Swachhata Hi Seva' (SHS) 2026 campaign, observing from September 17 to October 17.
The campaign theme is 'Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat', focusing on Cleanliness Target Units (CTUs), SafaiMitra welfare, and Waste-to-Wealth circular economy projects.
Key action points include a nationwide 'Shramdaan' drive on October 1 and special Urban Local Body council meetings on Swachh Bharat Diwas (October 2).

national_news.title: DRI Seizes Illegal Wildlife Products in Pan-India Anti-Trafficking Crackdown
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) conducted six intelligence-led operations across India, seizing leopard pelts, 180 live Indian Star Tortoises, 12 Tokay Geckos, 24 kg of pangolin scales, and tiger bones.
The Indian Star Tortoise (Geochelone elegans), leopard, and pangolin are protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, while pangolins are also listed under Appendix I of CITES.
Seizures and apprehended individuals were handed over to respective State Forest Departments and identified in coordination with the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB).

national_news.title: India Outlines Strategy for Women Entrepreneurship at BRICS WBA Forum
bullets: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal outlined three major hurdles for global trade entrants: credit access, market access, and predictable rules during the BRICS WBA Conference.
Revealed that out of 560 million small business loans extended in India, over 68% have been awarded to women entrepreneurs.
Targeted an increase in female workforce participation from 19% a decade ago to over 50%, aligning with developed economic benchmarks.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Eight Railway Multitracking Projects Worth Over Rs 20,800 Crore
bullets: The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved eight railway multitracking projects worth over Rs 20,800 crore across nine states.
The projects will cover 1,196 km across 31 districts, improving connectivity to about 2,100 villages with a combined population of 52 lakh, and are targeted for completion by 2029-30.
The Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train project's initial 100 km section from Surat to Vapi in Gujarat is scheduled to commence next year.

national_news.title: India and Sri Lanka Sign MoUs on L70 Guns Upgradation and Defence Cooperation
bullets: India and Sri Lanka exchanged MoUs on the upgradation of L70 air defence guns for the Sri Lankan Air Force and cooperation between National Cadet Corps and National Defence Colleges.
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh visited Sri Lanka and met President Anura Kumara Dissanayake and Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya in Colombo.
Both leaders virtually inaugurated three Bailey Bridges constructed by the Indian Defence Forces, reaffirming mutual commitment to regional security.

national_news.title: India Wins Two Gold and Four Bronze at World Archery Para Series Stage III in Ahmedabad
bullets: India concluded its World Archery Para Series Stage III campaign in Ahmedabad with two gold and four bronze medals.
Sheetal Devi won the para compound women's individual gold medal through a dramatic shoot-off against Kazakhstan’s Aizada Seidan.
Paralympics champion Harvinder Singh and Bhawna secured the gold medal in the para recurve mixed team event by defeating China.

national_news.title: India Endorses Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security at G20 Innovation Ministerial
bullets: India endorsed the Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security, joining like-minded governments to shape 6G wireless communication standards.
Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia announced the endorsement on the sidelines of the G20 Innovation Ministerial held in North Carolina, USA.
The initiative aims to secure 10 percent of global 6G standards and coordinate national strategies ahead of expected rollout in the 2030s.

national_news.title: National Consumer Helpline Facilitates Rs 105 Crore Refunds at Pre-Litigation Stage
bullets: The National Consumer Helpline (NCH) facilitated refunds exceeding 105 crore rupees across 35 sectors over a 15-month period from 25th April 2025 to 31st July 2026.
The initiative falls under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, providing timely relief at the pre-litigation stage without approaching Consumer Commissions.
The e-commerce sector recorded the highest grievances and refunds (over Rs 74 crore), followed by Travel and Tourism (exceeding Rs 10 crore).
NCH operates via a convergence-based mechanism, offering grievance redressal in 17 languages across pan-India channels.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Fixes 10th of Every Month for Social Security Pension via DBT
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that social security pension payments will be transferred directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) on the 10th of every month.
Disbursed ₹1,233.87 crore as pension for August 2026 to 105.68 lakh beneficiaries at the rate of ₹1,100 per person, while adding 98,896 new beneficiaries.
Inaugurated infrastructure development work for widening National Highway-333 in Munger to improve connectivity between Munger and Jamui.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Announces Fixed DBT Pension Schedule, Health Screening and School Abhiyan
bullets: Fixed the 10th of every month for transferring social security pensions via DBT, disbursing ₹1,233.87 crore to 105.68 lakh beneficiaries at ₹1,100 each.

Announced a state health screening drive from September 1 to November 30, 2026, aiming to screen 6.5 crore citizens, along with 'Seva Sankalp Kayakalp Abhiyan' starting September 17 to improve school infrastructure.
Laid foundation for widening NH-333 and detailed a ₹150 crore development project for the Munger-Jamui forest area, including eco-tourism facilities at Bhim Bandh.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Partner with Google India to Train School Teachers in AI Skills
bullets: Bihar is set to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Google India to strengthen Artificial Intelligence (AI) skills among school teachers.
The agreement will be signed between the Director of SCERT (State Council of Educational Research and Training) and Google India.
The initiative aims to expand technology-based learning across state schools, Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls' Schools, and secondary schools with ICT labs.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Unveils Sugarcane Industry Investment Promotion Policy 2026
bullets: The Bihar government announced the Sugarcane Industry Investment Promotion Policy 2026 to establish 25 new sugar mills and ancillary units, providing 30-year land leases up to 40 acres at a token rate of Re 1.
Under the policy, new sugar mills with a minimum capacity of 3,500 TCD (tonnes of cane per day) will receive a capital grant of Rs 70 crore.
Capital grants of 15% (up to Rs 5 crore) are offered for ethanol units and Compressed Biogas (CBG) plants, while 10 MW+ cogeneration plants receive up to 20% (max Rs 15 crore).

bihar_news.title: Prayas Group Recommends 40% Technical Minimum Operational Level for Thermal Power in Bihar
bullets: Energy policy think-tank Prayas submitted recommendations to the Bihar Electricity Regulatory Commission (BERC) regarding the draft Bihar Electricity Grid Code 2026.
It urged BERC to recognize a 40% technical minimum operational capability for coal plants instead of 55%, aligning with Central Electricity Authority (CEA) 2023 regulations.
The group recommended structuring grid tariffs and peak/off-peak hours based on 'net load' to accommodate higher integration of variable solar and wind power.

bihar_news.title: AAI Floats Tender for Saharsa Airport Upgrade in Bihar's Kosi Region
bullets: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has issued a tender worth ₹42.52 crore for the development and upgradation of Saharsa Airport.
The Bihar government is providing 12 acres of land for the airport project at an estimated cost of ₹147 crore.
The project aims to significantly boost air connectivity, trade, and tourism in Bihar's Kosi region.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Revises Monthly Honorarium for Contractual Medical Faculty and Doctors
bullets: Bihar's Health Department announced a retrospective revision of monthly honoraria effective from September 1, 2026, for medical faculty and resident doctors in state-run medical colleges.
Monthly remuneration was increased for contractual Professors (₹1.80 lakh to ₹2.07 lakh), Associate Professors (₹1.35 lakh to ₹1.55 lakh), and Assistant Professors (₹1.10 lakh to ₹1.25 lakh).
Honoraria for Senior Residents and Tutors were raised to ₹1.15 lakh, while Junior Residents' pay increased from ₹65,000 to ₹75,000 per month.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Develop Bodh Gaya as Major Eco-Tourism Hub
bullets: The Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department of Bihar is developing Bodh Gaya into an eco-tourism hub.
Key sites targeted for nature-based tourism include Maya Sarovar, Muchalinda Sarovar, Dungeshwari area, and surrounding hills.
Planned activities feature nature walks, trekking, bird-watching, nature camps, and eco-friendly accommodations to boost tourism and local handicrafts.

bihar_news.title: Severe Floods Impact Over 40 Lakh People Across 14 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Floods affected over 40.21 lakh people across 514 gram panchayats in 14 districts of Bihar due to incessant rain and heavy rainfall in catchment areas of Nepal.
According to the Disaster Management Department (DMD), September rainfall recorded 79.6 mm, which is 31 percent above normal.
The Ganga river at Sultanganj in Bhagalpur crossed its previous Highest Flood Level (HFL) of 36.75 metres (recorded in 2021) to reach 36.78 metres.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Industries Department Signs MoU with AIM Global Foundation for Food Processing Park
bullets: The Industries Department of Bihar signed an MoU with AIM Global Foundation at the AIM Congress 2026 in Dubai.
The partnership aims to establish an integrated agri-food and food processing cluster backed by investments from the UAE and Gulf region.
The initiative seeks to connect Bihar's farmers and industries with global supply chains ahead of the Rising Bihar 2026 summit.

bihar_news.title: Indian States Pitch for Gulf Investments in UAE
bullets: Indian states including Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, and Punjab are actively engaging with Gulf investors, sovereign wealth funds, and family offices in the UAE.
The outreach focuses on pitching manufacturing, agriculture, mining, logistics, and technology capabilities, utilizing the UAE as a gateway to global markets.
States are offering customized incentives, industrial land, and sector-specific opportunities to attract big-ticket foreign investments.
